title: Transferring Fairness using Multi-Task Learning with Limited Demographic Information

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in model performance using the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds (ϵ-DEO) metric to compare recall and specificity rates across male and female demographic groups in clinical notes (MIMIC-III) and online reviews (Trustpilot).

Evaluating disparities using the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds (ϵ-DEO) metric across racial groups in social media datasets, utilizing dialectal proxies (African-American English vs. Standard American English) for Twitter sentiment and annotated racial categories for the HateXplain dataset.
Evaluating disparities using the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds (ϵ-DEO) metric across age groups (under 35 and over 45 years old) in the Trustpilot online reviews dataset.

Evaluating combined demographic disparities (specifically the intersection of gender and age) by applying a multi-task intersectional fairness loss and measuring the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds (ϵ-DEO) across the cross-products of orthogonal attributes.
